items.title: google/ax
items.description: Google's open agentic orchestration runtime
items.author: google
items.summary_zh: Google 开源了声明式 agent 编排运行时 AX：用 YAML 声明 Workspace 与 Task（含 git 仓库、goal 等字段），由它负责沙箱隔离、网络围栏和集群调度，底层基于 Agent Substrate，官方称单集群可跑数十亿任务。体验类似 Kubernetes，适合需要批量运行自主 agent 的团队，但核心协议仍在演进，稳定版前可能引入破坏性变更。
items.summary_en: AX is Google's open-source declarative orchestrator for agent workloads: you define Workspaces and Tasks in YAML, and it sandboxes them, fences their network, and schedules them across a cluster on top of Agent Substrate, with the project claiming billions of tasks per cluster. Its Kubernetes-like workflow should appeal to teams running autonomous agents in bulk, though the core concepts and protocols are still evolving and breaking changes are expected before a stable release.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受

items.summary_zh: 一位开发者在掘金记录了从 Cursor 转向 Codex 大半个月的真实感受。他称 Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 让他觉得 AI 更像是能自主完成任务的超级 Agent，形态上更接近下一阶段，适合正在两者间权衡的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: A developer on Juejin shares impressions after switching from Cursor to Codex for roughly half a month. Cursor, they write, delivered the first strong shock of AI-assisted coding, while Codex felt less like a coding assistant and more like a genuine super-agent, closer to the next stage. Useful for developers weighing the two tools.

items.title: 《2026年中国人工智能计算力发展评估报告》发布，智能体重塑算力基础设施，智能算力规模预计增长87.9%
items.summary_zh: IDC 与浪潮信息联合发布《2026 年中国人工智能计算力发展评估报告》，预测中国智能算力规模 2026 年达 2576.5 EFLOPS、同比增长 87.9%，同期 AI 算力市场规模 515 亿美元。报告称智能体正以乘数效应推高 Token 消耗，全球活跃智能体数量将从 2026 年的 7940 万个增至 2030 年的 22.16 亿个，城市榜前三为北京、杭州、深圳。
items.summary_en: IDC and Inspur's 2026 China AI Computing Power report projects the country's intelligent computing capacity at 2576.5 EFLOPS in 2026, up 87.9% year on year, with the AI compute market reaching $51.5 billion. It argues agents are multiplying token consumption: global active agents should grow from 79.4 million in 2026 to 2.216 billion by 2030, a 129.8% CAGR, while Beijing, Hangzhou and Shenzhen lead its city ranking.

items.summary_en: InfoQ analyses the 15 finalists of GOAI's "Agent Infra" track, arguing the competition is shifting from model capability to system capability, with permission isolation, evidence chains, human gates, state read-back and rollback becoming shared engineering problems. Using projects such as DataFlow-Agent, CodeNotary, CyberGuard and RepoMesh, it says agents are moving from generating answers to delivering results, and multi-agent setups from role-play to shared responsibility.

items.title: Lambda SnapStart 现已支持容器镜像
items.summary_zh: AWS 把 Lambda SnapStart 扩展到以容器镜像打包的函数，此前该功能只覆盖 Python、.NET 和 Java 的托管运行时。SnapStart 在部署时对已初始化的执行环境做快照、调用时直接恢复，官方称启动时间已低于一秒；容器镜像上限 10 GB，远高于 ZIP 的 250 MB，因此为绕开体积限制而改用容器的团队不必再牺牲启动性能。
items.summary_en: AWS has extended Lambda SnapStart to functions packaged as container images; it previously covered only managed runtimes for Python, .NET and Java. SnapStart snapshots an initialized execution environment at deploy time and restores from it on invoke, and AWS says starts now take under a second. Since container images allow up to 10 GB versus 250 MB for ZIPs, teams that moved to containers for size no longer have to give up fast cold starts.

items.summary_zh: Android 17 QPR1 成为自 Android Honeycomb (3.x) 以来首个在没有向 AOSP 发布的情况下就为应用开发者新增 API 的版本，这些新 API 目前只在 Pixel OS 上提供，其他 Android OEM 拿不到（见官方 API diff 37.1）。对依赖 AOSP 或非 Pixel 设备做开发和测试的团队来说，API 可得性会明显分化。
items.summary_en: Android 17 QPR1 is the first release since Android Honeycomb (3.x) to add new APIs for app developers without a matching release to the Android Open Source Project, according to the linked API diff 37.1. Those APIs currently ship only in Pixel OS and aren't available to other Android OEMs, so anyone targeting non-Pixel devices can't count on them yet.

items.title: NVIDIA Personal AI Router 将 AI 任务分配到本地计算资源上
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 推出 Personal AI Router（PAIR）测试版，把本地网络中多台机器的推理能力聚合成单一入口，自动分派请求，并兼容 Ollama、LM Studio，无需改动底层架构或代理框架。它面向本地多代理负载，官方演示中组合 RTX Spark、DGX Spark 与 RTX 5090 后耗时约为单台笔记本的一半，但 NVIDIA 强调这不构成性能保证，PAIR 也不会合并 GPU 或显存。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA has released a beta of Personal AI Router (PAIR), which pools inference capacity from multiple machines on a local network and dispatches each request to a compatible node, integrating with Ollama and LM Studio without changes to agent frameworks. Aimed at local multi-agent workloads, its demo combining RTX Spark, DGX Spark and an RTX 5090 cut runtime to roughly half that of a single laptop, though NVIDIA stresses this is no performance guarantee and PAIR does not merge GPUs or VRAM.

items.title: 复杂业务 Agent 的持续进化：快手电商导购的 Harness Loop 实践｜QCon上海
items.summary_zh: 快手电商 AI 基座工程团队负责人包磊将在 QCon 上海站（10 月 22—24 日）的 Loop Engineering 专题，讲解《复杂业务 Agent 的持续进化：快手电商导购的 Harness Loop 实践》。导购横跨搜索推荐、营销优惠、交易履约与售后多个业务域，团队以统一 Tool 协议、动态上下文管理和多域工具编排构建生产级助手，应对工具膨胀、跨域信息冲突与错误传播。其结论是落地关键在可编排、可观测、可评测的 Harness 体系，而非模型能力本身。
items.summary_en: At QCon Shanghai, Bao Lei, who heads Kuaishou e-commerce's AI platform engineering team, will present the Harness Loop behind Kuaishou's shopping-guide agent. That agent spans search and recommendation, promotions, fulfillment and after-sales, and is built on a unified tool protocol, dynamic context management and cross-domain tool orchestration. His takeaway: shipping complex agents depends less on model capability than on an orchestrateable, observable and evaluable Harness engineering system.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: 这篇掘金文章从 Meta 讲的「算力过剩」故事和随后 AI 股的暴跌谈起，追问三年过去 AI 应用为何仍未爆发、AI 版的抖音微信小红书何时出现，以及这轮热潮会不会重演 2000 年的互联网泡沫。适合想看清 AI 投资热度与实际落地之间落差、而不是只看发布会的开发者。

items.title: agent-substrate/substrate
items.description: Agent Substrate: the core system
items.author: agent-substrate
items.summary_zh: Agent Substrate 是一个默认安全的 agent 执行运行时，做法是把多数时间处于闲置的 actor 多路复用到少量 worker 上，号称沙箱密度达标准容器运行时的 10 倍，支持 microVMs 和 gVisor，resume 在 500ms 内、每秒可完成 500 次以上 suspend/resume，并内置 zero-trust 内核与网络隔离。项目采用 Apache 2.0 许可，README 注明它不是 Google 官方支持的产品，适合需要大规模隔离运行自主 agent 的基础设施团队。
items.summary_en: Agent Substrate is a secure-by-default execution runtime for autonomous agents that multiplexes many mostly-idle actors onto a small pool of workers. Its README claims 10x the sandbox density of standard container runtimes, sub-500ms resumes, over 500 suspend/resume activations per second, zero-trust kernel and network isolation, and support for microVMs and gVisor under one lifecycle API. It ships under Apache 2.0 and is not an officially supported Google product.

items.summary_en: video-use is a 100% open-source tool that edits videos through Claude Code: drop raw footage into a folder, chat with the agent, and get a final.mp4. It cuts filler words and dead space, auto color grades segments, applies 30ms audio fades, burns subtitles, and can spawn parallel sub-agents to generate animation overlays via HyperFrames, Remotion, Manim, or PIL. It also self-evaluates every rendered cut, making it useful for creators who prefer coding-agent workflows over traditional video editors.

Developers tracking how agent engineering is maturing get a quick scan of what the community is actually building.

items.summary_zh: 前端开发者“小张同学”结合近期每天用 AI 写代码的体验，分享了一套 AI 全栈开发实践，并坦言手写代码能力已经明显下降。他认为按当前节奏，AI 编写代码会在更多场景替代人工。适合正在搭建 AI 辅助编程流程的开发者参考，也提醒自己别丢掉基本功。
items.summary_en: A front-end developer who goes by “小张同学” shares full-stack development practices built around writing code with AI every day. He admits his hand-coding ability has dropped noticeably and argues AI-generated code will keep replacing manual work in more scenarios. The post is useful for developers building AI-assisted workflows and doubles as a warning about foundational-skills atrophy.

items.title: 记录一种很新的大屏开发方式
items.description: 尝试用AI承接原本交给第三方团队的园区楼宇三维大屏开发：从Revit/IFC模型处理、网页资产与LOD轻量化，到Three.js园区场景、楼层构件交互，再以iframe接入Vue大屏
items.summary_zh: 作者记录了自己用 AI 接手原本外包给第三方团队的园区楼宇三维大屏开发流程，涵盖 Revit/IFC 模型处理、网页资产与 LOD 轻量化、Three.js 园区场景搭建、楼层构件交互，最后用 iframe 嵌入 Vue 大屏。文中给出了一条从模型到前端集成的完整链路，适合正在做三维可视化大屏、想评估 AI 能否替代外包环节的前端开发者参考。
items.summary_en: The author describes using AI to take over a park-building 3D dashboard project that would normally go to an outside team, covering Revit/IFC model handling, web asset and LOD optimization, a Three.js scene, floor-component interactions, and finally embedding it into a Vue dashboard via iframe. It lays out a full path from raw model to front-end integration, useful for front-end developers building 3D visualization dashboards who want to judge whether AI can replace outsourced work.

items.summary_zh: 文章从1800年前后一名英国手工织工讲起：他靠脚踏织机、手推梭子维生，价值全在一双手上，直到工厂里出现了新的织布机器。作者用这段历史类比当下 AI 对程序员的冲击，讨论技术替代与技能贬值。适合关心 AI 对职业前景影响的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The piece opens with an English handloom weaver around 1800, who made his living by foot and shuttle until a weaving machine appeared in the factory. It uses that history as a parallel for how AI may reshape programmers' work, asking what happens when a skill stops being the thing that pays. Aimed at developers weighing AI's effect on their careers.

The author's argument is that tech rests on capability and products rest on experience, noting the original title was harsher — aimed at developers following DeepSeek's releases.
